## Hi, I'm Lawrence

I'm an economist. By day I build economic models and monitoring tools; the rest of the time I play with data here. Every chart comes with the Python and an Excel version, so you can check my work or reuse the method.

[More about me, my papers and CV →](about.qmd){.mono}
